lcc_original: 挪亞生了三個兒子：閃、含、雅弗。
notes: UNV's 就是<WAH0853> introduces the three sons using the Hebrew direct-object marker את (WAH0853). LCC replaces 就是 with a colon「：」with no explicit lexical word for את. Since LCC has no word to host this tag, all three את markers are rendered as implicit {<WAH0853>} — matching the same pattern used for 含 and 雅弗 in UNV, and aligning with Rule 4.
